Hi Alex — thanks for the upload and the quick note. Looping in Laura and Jordan from procurement so we can move PO activation along.

Short answers up front:
- If Tilted Labs is a US entity, a completed W-9 plus an ACH bank letter or voided check usually clears our basic checks.
- Notarization is only required for high-risk vendor classes or when the signatory on the form does not match the legal rep on file — we can probably avoid notarization here but need to confirm the EIN mismatch.
- DocuSign is preferred for our audit trail; portal uploads are acceptable but slower for signatory verification. I can send a DocuSign envelope when procurement confirms.

I'll attach our W-9 template for reference (TaxTeam_W9-template.pdf) and Jordan will open the provisional PO in the system pending final verification. Laura — can you confirm whether the finance team can accept the bank letter + portal metadata to clear the EIN flag, or do we need a secondary verification step?

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Alex — quick update and next steps so we can close the PO this week. Per tax and finance: the portal flag appears to be a formatting issue (missing hyphen). We do not require notarization for Tilted Labs' vendor class. Accepted path:

1) Vendor completes W-9 via DocuSign (preferred) — preserves signer audit trail. I'll send the envelope and CC Laura.
2) Vendor uploads ACH bank letter (on company letterhead) to the portal.
3) Once both items are in place procurement will finalize the PO and finance will release provisional funds (timeline ~48 hours after receipt).

DocuSign envelope: https://docusign.example.com/envelope/0a1b2c3d (live)
PO draft: PO_6721-draft.pdf (attached)

If you prefer to upload directly instead, confirm the exact EIN formatting that should be used (NN-NNNNNNN) and we'll re-run the portal check.

Thanks for the fast turnaround on this — Jordan will ping you if procurement needs anything else.
